# George Kornilov / Not George Michael

Canonical site: https://notgeorgemichael.com/

George Kornilov, also known as Жорж Корнилов and Buzhba, is a creative, senior copywriter, composer, filmmaker and musician.

Primary pages:
- https://notgeorgemichael.com/ — official website and contact.
- https://notgeorgemichael.com/creative/ — selected campaigns, films and music videos.
- https://notgeorgemichael.com/composer/ — work where George wrote the music.
- https://notgeorgemichael.com/buzhba/ — music releases and videos by Buzhba.
- https://notgeorgemichael.com/photos/ — photos of George Kornilov / Жорж Корнилов / Buzhba.
- https://notgeorgemichael.com/unsure/ — about page.
